findings.draft_passage: The only idea which would have been quite unreasonable scarcely entered his mind. This was the thought of going westward and growing up with the country.
findings.source_has: Had these ideas been unreasonable, influences enough were at hand to correct them; but the point of the whole story…seemed to be that the ideas were more than reasonable; they were the logical, necessary, mathematical result of conditions old as history and fixed as fate…The only idea which would have been quite unreasonable scarcely entered his mind.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: 'the only' implies a contrast with a set of ideas already declared reasonable, but the draft cuts the entire evaluative frame establishing that contrast, leaving the superlative pivot hanging with no first side.

findings.draft_passage: Adams would have attached himself to Richardson in any case, as he attached himself to John LaFarge or Augustus St. Gaudens or Clarence King or John Hay, none of whom were at Harvard College.
findings.source_has: A student like H. H. Richardson, who came from far away New Orleans, and had his career before him to chase rather than to guide, might make valuable friendships at college. Certainly Adams made no acquaintance there that he valued in after life so much as Richardson, but still more certainly the college relation had little to do with the later friendship. Life is a narrow valley, and the roads run close together. Adams would have attached himself to Richardson in any case…
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader genuinely cannot place 'Richardson' — the name appears from nowhere as the anchor of a comparison, and the phrase 'in any case' implies a prior discussion of why Richardson mattered that the draft has entirely omitted, leaving the sentence's logical claim without any intelligible basis.

findings.draft_passage: in fifteen minutes the carriage was rolling down to Mals, swarming with German soldiers and German fleas, of which young Adams, thanks to his glimpse of Italy, never again felt quite the old confident charm.
findings.source_has: in fifteen minutes the carriage was rolling down to Mals, swarming with German soldiers and German fleas, worse than the Italian; and German language, thought, and atmosphere, of which young Adams, thanks to his glimpse of Italy, never again felt quite the old confident charm.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: the 'of which' grammatically attaches to 'German soldiers and German fleas,' making Adams lose his charm for fleas rather than for German language, thought, and atmosphere — the actual antecedent, which was cut.

findings.draft_passage: Russell's reply of September 5 reached the Legation on September 8, announcing that "instructions have been issued which will prevent the departure of the two ironclad vessels from Liverpool."
findings.source_has: Russell's reply to this note of September 5 reached the Legation on September 8" — making clear that September 5 is the date of Adams's note, not Russell's reply.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader with no source access would take 'Russell's reply of September 5' to mean a reply dated September 5, but the same sentence says it 'reached the Legation on September 8,' making the two dates irreconcilable and genuinely confusing — not merely less ornamented.

findings.draft_passage: yet one morning at breakfast there, sitting by her side—not for his own merits—Henry Adams heard her say to herself in her languid and liberal way, looking into her tea-cup: "I don't think I care for foreigners!"
findings.source_has: If there was in those days a country house in England which had a right to call itself broad in views and large in tastes, it was Bretton in Yorkshire; and if there was a hostess who had a right to consider herself fashionable as well as charming, it was Lady Margaret Beaumont; yet one morning at breakfast there, sitting by her side…" — 'there' is established as Bretton in Yorkshire, which the draft omits entirely.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: 'breakfast there' has no referent in the draft, so the reader cannot tell where this breakfast takes place or why Adams was present, making the scene spatially ungrounded in a way that obscures its meaning.

findings.draft_passage: One might as well imitate Shakespeare. He was a dramatist; a painter; a poet, like Carlyle.
findings.source_has: One might as well imitate Shakespeare. Yet evidently something was wrong here, for the poet and the historian ought to have different methods, and Macaulay's method ought to be imitable if it were sound; yet the method was more doubtful than the style. He was a dramatist; a painter; a poet, like Carlyle." — the intervening sentences re-establish Macaulay as the subject before 'He was a dramatist.'
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely misled: with the intervening sentences cut, 'He' immediately follows 'Shakespeare' as the nearest grammatical antecedent and will be read as describing Shakespeare, when it in fact describes Macaulay — reversing the intended meaning of the comparison.

findings.draft_passage: the old man Libri, after half an hour, made out a fragment of verse but could not identify a single odd word.
findings.source_has: The keeper says 'Take it to him!' pointing to Libri at a table in the manuscript room, introducing him as the one expert in Europe who might read the crayon writing — only then does Adams approach Libri.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: 'the old man Libri' appears with no introduction, no referral, and no explanation of why Adams sought him out — the keeper's directive that bridges the two figures was cut, leaving Libri's appearance unmotivated and his identity unestablished.

findings.draft_passage: By chance Adam Badeau, Grant's military biographer, took rooms in the same house, and the two men dined together.
findings.source_has: By chance it happened that Adam Badeau took the lower suite of rooms at Dohna's, and, as it was convenient to have one table, the two men dined together and became intimate.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader with no source access is genuinely confused: the draft has not named or particularised any specific dwelling earlier in the chapter — 'modest bachelor's quarters far out on G Street' gives no landmark a definite reference can attach to — so 'the same house' points to nothing and leaves the reader unable to place the scene.

findings.draft_passage: Sam Hoar taught Adams the charm of Washington spring.
findings.source_has: Judge Hoar brought his son Sam to Washington, and Sam Hoar loved largely and well. He taught Adams the charm of Washington spring.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: 'Sam Hoar' appears as the subject of the chapter's opening sentence with no prior mention anywhere in the draft, leaving the reader unable to place who he is or why he figures here.

findings.draft_passage: Adams saw no reason why it should be denied.
findings.source_has: Adams repeated the story to Godkin, who made much play with it in the Nation, till it was denied. Adams saw no reason why it should be denied.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: the draft contains no mention of anyone denying anything, so 'it should be denied' has no antecedent — the sentence reads as a response to a denial that was never established in the draft.

findings.draft_passage: The good people who thought it did matter had a sort of right to guide.
findings.source_has: One cannot take one's self quite seriously in such matters; it could not much affect the sum of solar energies whether one went on dancing with girls in Washington, or began talking to boys at Cambridge. The good people who thought it did matter had a sort of right to guide.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: 'it' in 'thought it did matter' has no referent in the draft — the solar-energies sentence that established what 'it' was (whether one's choice of venue mattered) was cut, leaving 'it' pointing at nothing in the preceding draft text.

findings.draft_passage: he asked the Bursar about that drawing-room, for the house had been turned to base uses
findings.source_has: He remembered the drawing-room, on the left of the hall door, in which Mrs. Everett received them. He remembered a marble greyhound in the corner. [...] When Adams closed his interview with President Eliot, he asked the Bursar about his aunt's old drawing-room
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: 'that drawing-room' implies a specific room already identified, but the draft's preceding sentences mention only 'the old President's House' with no drawing-room named, so the demonstrative 'that' has no antecedent.

findings.draft_passage: When the year's teaching was done, Adams escaped westward, and on the slope of Long's Peak fell, by happy accident, into the arms of Clarence King — geologist, wit, and ideal American — whose friendship, begun in a one-cabin Estes Park, would last as long as either lived.
findings.source_has: This sentence closes the Ch 031 source as a transition, referencing Adams's teaching years (Ch 029–030). In the draft, the Adams-as-professor sequence (Ch 029–030) is an authorized removal, so 'the year's teaching' has no antecedent anywhere in the preceding draft chapters. The source established the teaching context across multiple prior chapters.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader genuinely cannot know what 'the year's teaching' refers to, since the draft's authorized removal of the professor/North American Review sequence (Ch 029–030) has eliminated all prior mention of Adams teaching; the reader is misled into thinking this is a reference to something established earlier in the abridgment when it was not.

findings.draft_passage: as an agent of motion, he preferred on the whole the vigor of the shark, with its chances of betterment
findings.source_has: At one moment of perplexity to account for this trait of Pteraspis, or shark, which seemed to have survived every moral improvement of society, he took to study of the religious press… as an agent of motion, he preferred on the whole the vigor of the shark
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: 'the shark' appears as though it has been established as a known referent, but the draft never glossed Pteraspis as 'shark' nor introduced any shark metaphor, so the phrase 'the vigor of the shark' is unmotivated and its meaning as a symbol of surviving predatory instinct is lost.

findings.draft_passage: He shouldered his pack and started for home. As soon as the Surrenden establishment broke up on October 17, Adams prepared to return home
findings.source_has: his obedience to the President's order was the gloomiest acquiescence he had ever smiled. Adams took dark views, too… He shouldered his pack and started for home. Adams had no mind to lose his friend without a struggle
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: the draft's immediately preceding sentence has 'he' referring to Hay, then 'He shouldered his pack' appears with no signal of subject-shift, followed by a sentence making Adams the subject—a reader cannot determine with confidence whether Hay or Adams shouldered the pack.

findings.draft_passage: Yet the difficulty abroad was far less troublesome than the obstacles at home. The Senate had grown more and more unmanageable.
findings.source_has: For the moment Hay had no ally, abroad or at home, except Pauncefote, and Adams always maintained that Pauncefote alone pulled him through. Yet the difficulty abroad was far less troublesome than the obstacles at home.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely misled: 'far less troublesome' is a comparative that requires the reader to have just learned that difficulty abroad was itself substantial; the draft cut the Pauncefote passage that established that premise, so 'yet' pivots against nothing and the comparative has no referent.

findings.draft_passage: Yet for Adams its value lay chiefly in its occult mechanism.
findings.source_has: Yet the dynamo, next to the steam-engine, was the most familiar of exhibits. For Adams's objects its value lay chiefly in its occult mechanism.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader is genuinely confused: the 'Yet' signals a contrast with a prior claim that the dynamo was the most familiar/ordinary of exhibits, but that claim was cut from the draft, leaving the pivot dangling against a sentence praising the dynamo as 'the most expressive'—the opposite of the contrast intended.

findings.draft_passage: By the necessity of their philosophical descent, each member of the fraternity denounced the other as unequal to his lofty task and inadequate to grasp it.
findings.source_has: This wing of the anarchistic party consisted rigorously of but two members, Adams and Bay Lodge … By the necessity of their philosophical descent, each member of the fraternity denounced the other as unequal to his lofty task.
findings.gate_test_answer: A reader of the draft genuinely cannot tell who the second 'member of the fraternity' is — Bay Lodge has never appeared in the draft — making 'each member … denounced the other' unresolvable rather than merely less ornamented.
